# perseus-anglit fixtures (PerseusDL canonical-angLit, CC BY-SA 3.0 US)

Retrieved 2026-09-04 from the repo's master raw files, WHOLE and
untrimmed (the repo's entire data tree is one work): Klaeber's 1922
Beowulf (perseus-ang1, 258 KB) + the aligned English translation
(perseus-eng1, 187 KB), in the repo layout data/anon/beowulf/. No
__cts__.xml exists upstream — the missing-metadata fallback is part of
what these fixtures document, along with the P4-era header (bare
<refState> refsDecl, nil edition-div @n) and the legacy character
entities (&aeligmacr; et al., no DTD).
